biotools.summary: Stack-OglyPred-PLM is a computational tool that predicts O-linked glycosylation sites in proteins using a stacked generalization framework and embeddings from pre-trained protein language models. The tool is available on GitHub and has demonstrated high predictive performance on benchmark datasets.
